summary: First iteration full-stack testing of HIMT AI Chatbot. Backend: 16/17 pytest passed (94%). All admin auth, stats, facts, logs, reingest, health, cache, insufficient handling, contact/admissions retrieval, and grounded RAG chat work correctly. Frontend: Landing page + floating chat widget + admin dashboard all functional; login flow, chat send via prompt and via input+button, source chips, toast on reingest, and log filters all confirmed working. One backend retrieval-quality failure: 'What courses does HIMT offer?' returns generic pages (industry-reviews, discounts-and-offers) not course pages. Also observed retrieval quality issues on frontend: 'Tell me about HIMT' returned only 1 source (industry-reviews) and extracted contact facts contain non-HIMT emails (pridehotel, myftpupload) suggesting ingestion pulls unrelated content.

minor.issue: Query 'What courses does HIMT offer?' returns grounded answer but sources are industry-reviews/ and discounts-and-offers/ pages instead of course/modular/training pages. Retrieval/intent boosting for 'courses' intent is not surfacing course pages.
Structured facts include non-HIMT emails/phones (reservations.chennai@pridehotel.com, help@ebd.fab.myftpupload.com). Ingestion should filter emails to himt* domains only.

Query 'Tell me about HIMT' returns only 1 source and the source is /industry-reviews/ rather than the homepage or /about/. Ranking should prefer canonical /about-himt or landing page for 'about' intent.

action_items: Improve retrieval/ranking for 'courses' intent: boost URLs matching /course, /modular, /training, /mca or intent_tag='courses' so course pages appear as sources instead of industry-reviews/discounts.
Filter structured facts extraction: only accept emails matching *@himt*.com / *@himtmarine.com / *@himtcollege.com etc.; drop emails from third-party embedded content.
Ranking for 'about' intent: boost the homepage / /about-himt / /about-us URLs so 'Tell me about HIMT' cites the primary about page, not /industry-reviews/.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py couples startup ingestion with request path — consider gating the on-startup crawl behind an env flag to avoid unintended external HTTP on every cold start.
_ask_llm swallows all exceptions to fallback — verify OPENAI real errors are logged (currently logger.exception is present, ok).
ingestion.py extracts emails/phones without domain allowlisting → leaks non-HIMT contacts (see facts issue above).
retrieval.py intent boost values likely too weak for /courses/ URLs — test_chat_courses shows generic pages winning.
test_credentials: Admin token: himt-admin-2026 (X-Admin-Token header). No test_credentials.md file exists in /app/memory/.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing 30 pages / 248 chunks from initial ingestion used. Chat cache seeded via test queries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend tests written in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest with xdist). Public URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Only failing test: TestChat.test_chat_courses due to retrieval quality — fixture matches k in [course, modular, training, mca, dg] against joined source URLs. If retrieval is improved to prefer course pages this will pass. Cache test uses a unique query per run to avoid stale-cache flakes. Reingest test only checks that the new run_id shows up in /admin/runs; it does not wait for completion (took ~9s in prev runs).
rca of the issue: test_chat_courses failure — RCA: retrieve() in retrieval.py appears to rank chunks by lexical overlap + intent-tag boost, but pages like /industry-reviews/ and /discounts-and-offers/ contain the words 'course/courses/modular' densely, out-scoring the actual course-listing pages. Fix: (a) increase URL-path boost (e.g., +5) when page_url contains /course, /modular, /training, /mca/, /dg-shipping; (b) ensure intent_tag='courses' chunks receive higher additive boost; (c) optionally de-prioritise pages tagged as reviews/offers/blog for course intent.
